# Linux: PowerPC port of Robin Hood

- Source: [amiga-news.de](https://www.amiga-news.de/en/news/AN-2006-07-00103-EN.html)
- Date: 30 July 2006, 12:25
- Source credited to: [Pegasos.org](http://pegasos.org/index.php?name=News&file=article&sid=1131)
- Author: snx; translation: cad
- Language: English

The strategy game [Robin Hood](http://www.rune-soft.com/englisch/Projektseiten/robin/robin.html) - The Legend of Sherwood, distributed by Rune Soft for Mac OS X and Linux/x86, is now also available for Linux-operated PowerPC computers thanks to the assistance of Gunnar von Boehn.

A demo version can be downloaded under the [title link](http://www.greyhound-data.com/gunnar/robinhood/).

The currently distributed CDs of the Linux/x86 full version can be installed under Linux/PPC as well; a 3 MB-large PowerPC update is required for the operation, which will also be available on the Rune Soft web page within the next few days.
